summary: Vehicle Settlement & Fee Passing - Iteration 133. Tested Phase 5 Stripe Intermediary Handshake features: fee calculation formula, fee-preview endpoint, seller-contact gate, settlement status, webhook handlers, and auto-charge trigger. All 21 backend tests passed.

fee_calculation_formula.details: Formula verified: net_commission = hammer * 0.025, total = (net + 0.30) / (1 - 0.029). Tested with $1,000, $10,000, $50,000 hammer prices.

fee_preview_endpoint.details: GET /api/vehicle-settlement/fee-preview/{hammer_price} returns correct fee breakdown with bilingual strings (breakdown_en, breakdown_fr). Rejects negative/zero prices with 400.

seller_contact_no_settlement.details: GET /api/auctions/{id}/seller-contact returns 402 with bilingual message (message_en, message_fr) when no settlement exists

settlement_status_pending_close.details: GET /api/vehicle-settlement/{auction_id}/status returns PENDING_CLOSE when no settlement exists

calculate_vehicle_fee_service.details: vehicle_fee_service.py calculate_vehicle_fee returns correct amounts for various hammer prices

webhook_handlers.details: webhooks.py handles payment_intent.succeeded and payment_intent.payment_failed for vehicle_platform_fee type

auction_handler_auto_charge.details: vehicle_auction_handler.py triggers create_vehicle_fee_charge on auction close (line ~219)

migration_script.details: add_vehicle_settlement_fields.py migration script exists with proper structure

critical_code_review_comments: Code implementation is solid. Fee calculation formula correctly recovers Stripe fees.
Bilingual support (EN/FR) properly implemented in fee-preview and seller-contact endpoints.
Webhook handlers properly dispatch to vehicle_fee_service handlers based on transaction_type metadata.
Auto-charge trigger in vehicle_auction_handler.py is correctly placed after auction sold status update.
